headline: Tech strength lifts market as Nasdaq outpaces broader indices
deck: Growth stocks lead a modest rally as investors digest AI momentum and corporate buyback strategies.
body:
The market opened with a cautiously optimistic tone, with the Nasdaq climbing 0.88% to lead the three major indices—outpacing the S&P 500's 0.67% gain and the Dow's more modest 0.20% advance. This tech-heavy performance reflects sustained investor enthusiasm around artificial intelligence, with coverage of Microsoft's continued AI pivot and Nvidia's record-high potential suggesting that mega-cap technology remains the market's primary driver. Meanwhile, the 10-Year Treasury ticked up 4 basis points to 5.28%, a move that typically weighs on growth stocks but hasn't derailed today's rally.

The headlines point to a market increasingly focused on AI narratives and corporate capital allocation decisions. Wall Street's bullish stance on Microsoft's AI strategy, paired with close attention to Nvidia's massive buyback program, underscores how investors are parsing both fundamental business shifts and shareholder-friendly actions in the tech sector. SpaceX's resurgence also suggests investor appetite for innovation-driven stories beyond traditional software and semiconductors.

With multiple segments of the market in focus—from transportation stocks to AI plays—today's gains reflect selective strength rather than broad-based enthusiasm. The modest overall index moves mask underlying momentum in growth names, while the Dow's lagging performance hints that value and traditional industrial exposure remain less favored in the current environment.
